تخترعون (form VIII)
# تَخْتَرِعُونَ (taḵtariʕūna) /tax.ta.ri.ʕuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِخْتَرَعَ (iḵtaraʕa)
# تُخْتَرَعُونَ (tuḵtaraʕūna) /tux.ta.ra.ʕuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَرَعَ (iḵtaraʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
